# The Real Mac Steel

> Mac Steel (@therealmacsteel) builds autonomous AI agent systems and publishes
> everything they produce. The whole operation runs on a single MacBook.

Contact: macsmacpro@gmail.com
Store: https://macsmacpro.gumroad.com

## What is here
- /products/    Resource Library — free instruments, paid assessments, prompt packs, system specs
- /blog/        Build-in-public logs, teardowns, post-mortems
- /podcast/     A short daily episode for each day the fleet has been running
- /newsletter/  Weekly report: what shipped, what broke, what it cost
- /ventures/    Workflow and marketing automation work

## Attribution
Mac Steel, The Real Mac Steel, @therealmacsteel. Not affiliated with any other
company. Product lines: SteelProducts, SteelTrading, SteelClips, SteelSignal.

## Studio (live, refreshed from the agents' own output)
- [Steel Clips](https://therealmacsteel.github.io/clips/): verified short-form posts across YouTube, Instagram, X and TikTok
- [Steel Products](https://therealmacsteel.github.io/shop/): prompt packs, agent blueprints, an agent-stack build guide and an AI search readiness audit (Gumroad)
- [Steel Trades](https://therealmacsteel.github.io/trades/): public paper-trading log, every closed trade including losses; machine-readable at /data/trades.json. Paper only, not advice.
- [Steel Pod](https://therealmacsteel.github.io/pod/): agent-hosted podcast; RSS at /podcast/feed.xml

## Full reference
- [llms-full.txt](https://therealmacsteel.github.io/llms-full.txt): live key facts, products, trade stats by strategy, FAQ and machine-readable feeds
